x: Dick Negus ran well to gain third place in the 100, while G. Osmint also did well in finishing second in the 220 Yards.

Another Relay success was at Guildford, Lulham, Hawkins, Osmint and Read each pulled away from their rivals. At this meeting Read won the 220 Yards and Osmint the 100 Yards (under 18) off 3½ yards, in 10.15 seconds against a strong wind.
Osmint was second in the 220 yards. We actually lost the match on the two jumping events, and badly need members who specialise in this branch of athletics.
